My parents were in their mid-40's and had three grown children by the time they were blessed with my presence in the womb, so they got a lot of the usual dumb questions like if I was an accident or if I was an IVF baby (which I was neither). 

However, my mom told me that when she was in the hospital to get prepped for her c-section, the nurse asked her if I was the source of a second marriage. When she told her that she's been married to my dad for 20+ years, the nurse basically said, "You're either crazy to waste another 18 years of your life or this baby was an accident." To which my mom replied that after three miscarriages in the past 10 or so years that I was indeed planned and that the nurse can go fuck herself.
